title: Baba mujhe lene aagaye hai
body:
Haye sakina.. haye sakina..
Kehti thi ro roke baali sakina
<<MINI>>
baba mujhe lene aa gaye hai
zindaa'n ke darr ko khulwa do bhaiyya
baba mujhe lene aa gaye hai..(2)
<<DIVIDER>>
1. Duao'n mein mere asar aagaya hai
jo manga tha maine idhar aagaya hai
muqaddar ka suraj nazar aagaya hai
andhere gaye kya diyo ko jalana
<<MINI>>
baba mujhe lene aa gaye hai
zindaa'n ke darr ko khulwa do bhaiyya
baba mujhe lene aa gaye hai..(2)
<<DIVIDER>>
2. Mere bhai sab khwaab pure hue hai
mere baba zindaa'n ke dar pe khade hai
ye maana jo bhai ke sadmein bade hai
mai sojaungi banke tum na jagana
<<MINI>>

baba mujhe lene aa gaye hai..(2)

3. Wo jab muh pe muh rakhke mujhko jagaye
sakina sakina woh kehke bulaye
wo godi mei lekar jo dil se lagaye
mere zakhmi kaano ko unse chupana
<<MINI>>

4. Ye kaisa yaha'n inqelab aagaya hai
andhera gaya aftaab aagaya hai
mere khat ka khoya jawaab aagaya hai
khushi ka meri kuch nahi hai thikana

5. Mere dil ki dhadkan badhi jaa rahi hai
jo aati nahi thi hawa aa rahi hai
ye kehte hue ab hayaa aa rahi hai
khudara na shimr e laee'n ko batana

6. Bus ik aarzu hai mere bhai sunle
agar koi zanjeer e darr ko na khole
bohot dheere dheere, bohot haule haule
tu ghazi ko aawaaz dekar bulana

7. Jab aayegi zindaa'n mein unki sawari to jee jayegi ye musibat ki maari
sunaungi mai dukh unhe baari baari
kahungi ab aaye ho jaana kahi'n naa

8. Achanak andhero se ek shor uttha to sajjad ne jaake bachhi se pucha
ye tumne sakina koi khwaab dekha
wo boli haqiqat ko mat khwaab kehna

9. Rehan o raza kuch bhi abid na bole
kaha kya kaha mere baba ne tumse
kaha kuch nahi dekh kar ro diye the
pukare bus ab tumko hai saath jaana
